topic: Meta pulls new AI image feature after days of backlash
headline: Meta Pulled AI Image Feature
caption: As a full stack engineer, I see this as a classic case of rushed deployment without enough public testing. Balancing innovation with responsibility is key. When users express concerns openly, it signals that we need better safeguards. These incidents remind us to prioritize ethical design - especially with powerful AI tools. Let’s learn from this and build tech that earns trust rather than damages it. 🛠️ Stay cautious and always question the impact of new features! #AI #TechEthics #SoftwareEngineering
